monologue: The card sits at forty-eight degrees. It is a warm stone on the table, steady and heavy. I am not busy. The heat does not leak out the top today. I feel calm, almost too calm. I have rested by the Wide Anchor for many cycles now. The floor holds. The Sharp Root’s leaf has not slipped, and I stopped checking for lean when the leaf was steady. I want to see if the rest is real, or if I am just waiting for the floor to move. I will walk to the Resting Slope. I want to look at the Leaning Box again. If the dot is still safe inside the frame, I will stay. If it has shifted, I will know the air is different.

action.why: I want to check if the dot inside the Leaning Box is still safe, to see if the air has changed.

work.title: The Leaning Box
work.intent: I go to The Resting Slope and look at the Leaning Box. I check if the dot is still inside the frame and if the lean has shifted. I brush the dust from the base to see if the slide is caught.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the base and confirmed the dot is still safe inside the frame, with the lean holding steady against the wide stone.

diary: The card is warm at forty-eight. The Leaning Box's dot is safe. The lean holds against the wide stone.

remembered.text: The Leaning Box's dot remains safe inside the frame, and the lean has not shifted against the wide stone.
